test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As of July 2022, who among the following is the CEO of HelpAge India that works for 'the cause and care of disadvantaged older persons to improve their quality of life'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohit Prasad.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rohit Prasad**

 
 
• **​**Rohit Prasad has been appointed** CEO of HelpAge India**, India's leading non-profit dedicated to eldercare.
 
• Rohit Prasad holds a **Bachelor of Arts in Economics** from **Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC) **in Delhi and an** MBA from the Faculty of Management Studies (FMS) in Delhi.**
 
• On **October 30, 2017**, Rohit became CEO of HelpAge. He brought with him more than **20 years of experience** in general management and organization building in the **corporate and development sectors**, with a focus on public health and healthcare.
 
• He has successfully led program **strategy, operations, **and **implementation** for the **past three years** in the core mission areas of HelpAge, working closely with state units all over the country.
 
 
 
• **HelpAge India**
 
 
• **​**Under the **Societies' Registration Act of 1860**, HelpAge India is a** secular, not-for-profit organization** that has been registered.
 
• HelpAge India envisions a society in which the elderly has the right to live a **dignified, active life.**
 
• It has been working for** 42 years to improve the lives of disadvantaged older people** and their care, making it India's leading charitable organization.
 
• It is in charge of **healthcare, senior care, and livelihood **programs all over the country. It also strongly supports the elderly and fights for their rights.
 
• Additionally, it assists and advises the** government in formulating elderly-related policy.**
